**Status of the two remaining criteria, 2026-07-29. Neither is marked met — read this before assuming either is done.**

## `46cfc848` — half verified, half untestable

The criterion has two halves and only the first is demonstrable here.

**Verified (jj/git lane).** Against released ccx v0.39.0, in an isolated worktree of cc-context carrying a single-line fix:
```
$ ccx vcs ship --no-watch --draft -m "…" --pr-title "…" --pr-body-file /tmp/pr-body.md
hooks ok · committed 9689c14 · pushed fix-ship-help-graphite-demote → origin · opened PR #3 … [draft]
$ gh pr view 3 --json body,isDraft --jq '{chars:(.body|length), draft:.isDraft}'
{"chars":1594,"draft":true}
```
Ship opened the branch's PR with a non-empty body, as a draft.

**Not verified (gt submit backfill).** "Sets bodies on every bodyless PR in a gt submit" needs a repo where Graphite can *actually* submit. It cannot be tested on any yasyf-owned repo, because Graphite refuses all of them — "does not have the necessary permissions" — which is the very condition T1 exists for. The only Graphite-submittable repos available are `Forge-AI/monorepo` and `interview-tools`, both real shared work repos where opening throwaway stacked PRs is not appropriate. This half needs either a deliberate decision to test on a work repo, or a Graphite-enabled scratch repo created for the purpose.

## `d5d90931` — blocked, not attempted

`/open-pr` cannot be invoked: the `open-pr` plugin is present in the cc-skills marketplace (`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:70`) but **not installed in the running session**, so the skill does not resolve. Installing a plugin into the user's environment was not in scope to do unasked. Unblocking it is a one-time install, after which the end-to-end run (lane report → guidelines card → style scout with cache reuse → created branch → PR → named background watcher) can be exercised.

A second constraint applies even once installed: the skill hands off to `pr-style-scout` and `pr-watcher` subagents, and subagent spawning has been failing on account limits ("Usage credits are required for fast mode", and a weekly limit that reset 2026-07-29 00:00 PT). The watcher hand-off is part of what this criterion asserts, so it cannot be verified while agent spawning is down.

## Note on the PR itself

PR #3 is not a throwaway. It corrects `ccx vcs ship --help`, which still documented the *pre*-0.39.0 gate ("a probe that times out … keeps the lane rather than demoting") — the binary was describing the bug as though it were the design. The matching fragment fix landed as `yasyf/cc-skills@f500d7d`. Left as a draft pending a decision to merge or close.
